{{Quote|Watch below. The Emperor himself chose the banner of Lord Nankrang.|[[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]] to [[Qawohl]]|<ref name="The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
[[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Nankrang''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the time of the [[Great Galactic War]]. He received praise at [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] for his victories against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
